name: crossgen
description: Generate, edit, and organize images through a local CrossGen installation.

interface.shortDescription: Local image generation, editing, and Gallery workflows.
interface.longDescription: CrossGen owns provider credentials, model capability checks, the durable generation queue, History, and Gallery state. The bundled MCP server exposes model discovery, generation, editing, inpainting, job monitoring, asset inspection, and export to Codex and other MCP hosts.
